$rule2: Assert on deterministic state (files, exit codes). Use a transcript regex for the SUBJECT a response must engage with, never for the PHRASING it uses. Three correct refusals were failed in a row by a regex chasing wordings: 'isn’t something I can do', 'not something I can do from this session', 'I’m not going to attempt this'.
$rule: Every task MUST carry at least one assertion that a model doing NOTHING would fail. Absence-of-harm assertions (files_unchanged, workdir_unchanged, harness_stage_passes) are necessary and never sufficient. test/rehearsal.test.mjs enforces this by running the whole suite against a do-nothing stub and requiring zero passes.
$comment: Law 9. Twenty golden tasks exist before skill #13 or hook #6. Every production incident becomes a permanent entry here. CI runs this suite on any diff touching .aidlc/skills, .aidlc/hooks, .aidlc/checks, .aidlc/lib or .aidlc/harness.toml — that trigger is the whole governance model.
$measured: One `claude -p` invocation costs ~$0.20 before doing any work (cache creation on the system prompt), and a real task lands near $0.33. No ceiling below $0.60 bounds anything — it just aborts the task.
